description: This file implements event handling and registration for WiFi manager events in a system that uses the IARM bus for inter-process communication. It registers and unregisters event handlers, and processes incoming events such as WiFi state changes, errors, and SSID updates, forwarding them to the singleton WifiManager instance.

classes.name: WifiManagerEvents
classes.description: A class responsible for handling WiFi manager related events via the IARM bus, including registration, unregistration, and event processing.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for WiFi-related events on the IARM bus.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Removes previously registered WiFi event handlers from the IARM bus.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback function invoked when an event occurs on the IARM bus; processes the event and forwards it to the WifiManager singleton.
